claim_boundary: Independent points give exact lower bounds only. Novelty means no Q-isomorphism in the pinned584-equation catalogue and41 earlier measured equations, not universal novelty. Censored point attempts are not upper bounds. All catalogue reads occurred after the fixed20-address batch.

rank_certificate.argument: Every integral relation is divisible by 2; E(Q)[2]=0 permits infinite descent. Hence all listed points are independent.
